# Questionably Country

For the first time in history, five country songs were at the top of the Billboard Hot 100. Ella Langley, Morgan Wallen, Taylor Swift and Stella Lefty all have songs that range from two-stepping hits to borderline Americana: what do these songs say about the state of country music?

**Songs Discussed**

- Dolly Parton, “9 to 5”

- Dolly Parton & Kenny Rogers, “Islands In the Stream”

- Ella Langley, “Choosin’ Texas”

- Taylor Swift, “I Knew You Were Trouble.”

- Stella Lefty, “Boston”

[Charlie Harding](https://switchedonpop.com/episodes?author=5dc85fbd5cdd8240dbc3e94f)
